title: A method on one page
description: What in your session repeats and what rests only on you; the session in steps; testing the method on two people.

units.title: What repeats and what rests on you
The test: a method for two

objectives.text: Split your last three sessions into elements that repeat and elements that are personal.
Describe a session in 4–7 steps, with the purpose and the time of each step.
For each step, decide whether it holds two people at once and what to change in it.
